Container.Name: simstudio-app
Container.Overview: Sim Studio is an AI-powered development environment for building and testing agents. This is the main application server providing the web interface, API, and collaboration features. Features: AI agent development, real-time collaboration, semantic search with vector embeddings, and integrated development tools. Requires: simstudio-db (PostgreSQL with pgvector), simstudio-realtime (WebSocket), and simstudio-valkey (session storage).
Container.Requires: Requires simstudio-db (PostgreSQL), simstudio-realtime (WebSocket), and simstudio-valkey (Redis) on the same Docker network (simstudio_internal). All three must be running and healthy before starting simstudio-app. IMPORTANT: Before adding this container, you must create the Docker network 'simstudio_internal' first. Follow these steps in Unraid: 1. Open Terminal (Go to Main, click Terminal button) 2. Run: docker network create simstudio_internal 3. Go to Settings > Docker 4. Set "Enable Docker" to "No" and click Apply 5. Set "Preserve user defined networks" to "Yes" and click Apply 6. Set "Enable Docker" to "Yes" and click Apply 7. The network is now ready for use with all Sim Studio containers

Config.Name: Port: Web UI
Config.Description: Sim Studio web interface and API port

Config.Name: --- Database ---
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection settings. Must match simstudio-db configuration.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection URL (format: postgresql://user:password@host:port/database). Must match simstudio-db.

Config.Name: --- Authentication & Security ---
Config.Description: Authentication and security configuration.

Config.Name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
Config.Description: Authentication secret key (shared with simstudio-realtime). Must be 32+ characters. Generate: openssl rand -base64 32

Config.Name: BETTER_AUTH_URL
Config.Description: Base URL for authentication (same as NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL)

Config.Name: INTERNAL_API_SECRET
Config.Description: Secret for internal service-to-service communication (shared with simstudio-realtime). Generate: openssl rand -base64 32

Config.Name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
Config.Description: Data encryption key for sensitive information. Generate: openssl rand -base64 32

Config.Name: API_ENCRYPTION_KEY
Config.Description: API-specific encryption key. Generate: openssl rand -base64 32

Config.Name: --- Application URLs ---
Config.Description: Public URLs and domain configuration.

Config.Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
Config.Description: Public application URL (e.g., http://your-server-ip:3000 or https://simstudio.example.com). Used by browser clients.

Config.Name: TRUSTED_ORIGINS
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of additional trusted origins for authentication (e.g., apex + www, aliases, reverse-proxy IPs). Leave empty to use only NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL.

Config.Name: --- Realtime & WebSocket ---
Config.Description: Real-time communication settings.

Config.Name: SOCKET_SERVER_URL
Config.Description: Internal URL for WebSocket server (container-to-container)

Config.Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SOCKET_URL
Config.Description: Public WebSocket URL for browser clients. Leave empty to use page origin (requires reverse proxy to route /socket.io). Set explicitly if realtime is on different host:port (e.g., wss://socket.example.com).

Config.Name: --- Valkey Session Storage ---
Config.Description: Redis/Valkey connection for session persistence.

Config.Name: REDIS_URL
Config.Description: Valkey connection URL (format: redis://host:port/db)

Config.Name: --- External APIs ---
Config.Description: Third-party API integrations.

Config.Name: COPILOT_API_KEY
Config.Description: GitHub Copilot API key for AI features

Config.Name: SIM_AGENT_API_URL
Config.Description: URL for Sim Agent API (e.g., http://agent-service:port)

Config.Name: OLLAMA_URL
Config.Description: Ollama API endpoint for local LLM inference (optional)

Config.Name: --- Performance ---
Config.Description: Performance tuning and resource limits.

Config.Name: ADMISSION_GATE_MAX_INFLIGHT
Config.Description: Maximum number of concurrent inflight requests to the admission gate

Config.Name: --- System ---
Config.Description: Node.js and timezone configuration.

Config.Name: NODE_ENV
Config.Description: Node.js environment (production/development)

Config.Name: Variable: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone. See: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones#List

Config.Name: --- Advanced ---
Config.Description: Advanced settings and debugging options.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Log verbosity: error, warn, info, debug
